inputs.name: server
inputs.description: The host that runs the Wazuh manager, indexer and dashboard together, as a map of one name to an address, or to a host object with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file, jump_hosts or os.

inputs.name: agents
inputs.description: Hosts that run the Wazuh agent, by name, in the same form as server. The server can't be one: Wazuh's manager and agent packages conflict, and the manager already watches its own host.

inputs.name: wazuh_version
inputs.description: Wazuh 4.x release to install on the server and the agents, without the package revision. Change filebeat_template_sha256 with it.

inputs.name: filebeat_template_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of extensions/elasticsearch/7.x/wazuh-template.json in the Wazuh source at wazuh_version.

inputs.name: manager_address
inputs.description: Address or name agents reach the manager on. When null, the server's address.

inputs.name: dashboard_address
inputs.description: Address the dashboard listens on. The default keeps it to the host itself, for a proxy or an SSH tunnel; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: api_address
inputs.description: Address the Wazuh API, on port 55000, listens on. The default keeps it to the host itself; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: indexer_heap
inputs.description: JVM heap of the indexer, as both -Xms and -Xmx, such as "1g" or "4g". Wazuh advises half the host's memory, and no more than 32g. The default suits the 8 GiB host Wazuh asks for.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password of admin, who signs in to the dashboard and the indexer. 8 to 64 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and one of . * + ? -, and no other symbols. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan. Changing it sets the new one.

inputs.name: api_password
inputs.description: Password of wazuh, the Wazuh API's administrator, under the same rules as admin_password. Ephemeral, like it. Changing it sets the new one.

inputs.name: enrollment_password
inputs.description: Shared secret agents present to the manager to enroll, such as the output of openssl rand -hex 16. Ephemeral, like admin_password. Keep it the same between runs, or every agent's file changes with it.
